## Highlights

- Keeps `usage-indicator update` explicitly user-triggered while moving execution from the stable launcher into a standalone cached UpdateHost.
- Downloads the installer and checksum, then verifies the installer before stopping a running indicator.
- Runs compatible upgrades silently through the guarded private update path and validates the installed version afterward.
- Restarts a previously running indicator only after a validated successful update, while preserving restart-required result `3010` without restarting the app.
- Keeps the one-time interactive transition for legacy installations.
- Cleans update temporary directories on success and failure, with clearer failure handling throughout the handoff.

[Compare `v0.2.0...v0.2.1`](https://github.com/mursyidd/usage-indicator-for-codex/compare/v0.2.0...v0.2.1)
